description: The official LumoAuth SDK for .NET: RBAC, Zanzibar and ABAC authorization checks, OAuth 2.1 / OIDC sign-in, AI-agent identity (approvals, Just-in-Time permissions, delegation) and AAuth RFC 9421 request signing. Add LumoAuth.AspNetCore for ASP.NET Core integration.

ASP.NET Core integration for the LumoAuth SDK: dependency injection from configuration, a bearer-token authentication scheme, OpenID Connect sign-in, [RequirePermission] / [RequireRelation] / [RequireAbac] authorization policies, and a health check.
NSail.Messaging.Sse, part of NSail Stack: a .NET modular-monolith framework (messaging, data, security, Blazor and React clients).
